name: half-fixed
description: Finds bug fixes that reached some sibling implementations but not the others, triages each one, and drafts contributions in the target repository's own style.

interface.shortDescription: Find fixes that only reached some sibling implementations.
interface.longDescription: half-fixed scans git history for changes made to some members of a sibling group (provider adapters, drivers, stores, platform ports) while the others still contain the old code. The agent triages each finding, fixes confirmed gaps with tests, and drafts pull requests in the target repository's own style.
defaultPrompt: Find half-fixed bugs in this repo.
Did my last fix reach every provider?
Check this branch for changes I only made to some siblings.
Draft a PR for this fix in the project's style.
